## Rule

Each output row = color **5** if all cells in that input row are equal (monochromatic), else color **0**. Grids are 3×3; input palette verified `{1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9}` (never 0/5) over the 200k corpus; output palette `{0,5}`. Verified 200000/200000.

## Cost analysis

Cost model here = memory + params. LIVE is a **single Einsum** (input→output, no intermediates → memory 0), so the entire cost is its initializer: `U[10,4]` = 40 params. The only sub-40 shape is a single input→output node (any billed intermediate on the 30×30 canvas is ≥ thousands of bytes); so the lever is shrinking the factor. The graph is `out[k,h,w] = Q[h,w]·Σ_t U[k,t]·(Σ_a n[a,h]U[a,t])²` — a **symmetric-CP rank-R** form of the routing tensor `C[a,d,k]=Σ_t U[a,t]U[d,t]U[k,t]`. R only needs to satisfy the decode inequalities (not exact values), and **R=3 suffices** with a clean ±1.0 margin → **cost 30**. R=2 is infeasible (see Attempts / hard_records).

### Floor proof (perfect-25 cost≤1 DISPROVEN; realized floor 30)
cost≤1 is impossible: (1) output colors {0,5} never appear in input → channels must be generated, forcing ≥1 routing constant; (2) the rule is a within-row equality predicate (a real nonlinear computation, not a shape-only identity/transpose/flip/rotate — local pre-scan found no zero-param rearrangement); (3) no no-payload direct-output op computes "row-monochromatic → paint 5 else 0". The floor is bounded below by the routing factor. Realized floor this batch = **30** (rank-3). A non-symmetric V/W factorization is the only untried sub-30 hypothesis but W must be [10,·] so params ≥ 10·rank(W); low EV vs the confirmed 30.
